title: Effect recipes v1 - one file per recipe under content/video_engine/effects/recipes/<slug>.json (P56 T1)
description: A recipe is the unit of authoring (E96, 2026-09-13): an ORDERED combination of catalogue effects with offsets, the sentence act it serves, and a played instant in an approved cut that proves it. A member names a card id from docs/EFFECTS-CATALOG.jsonl (or another recipe, acyclic) and may name one of that card's listed options; a member's title and `does` are pulled from its card at build (build_effects_catalog.py), never copied here. `proven` means the ordered members fire inside `window_s` at `proof.t` in `proof.timeline` on disk - the drift gate (effects_catalog_check.py) re-walks the timeline to check it; `candidate` means no cut has carried it yet and it carries no proof. One file per recipe: a recipe is the merge-collision unit.

card_or_recipe_id.description: a card id <axis>:<token> from docs/EFFECTS-CATALOG.jsonl, or another recipe's id (nesting; no cycles - the gate checks)

oneOf.description: [lo, hi] when the seed fired at a range of offsets

offset.description: seconds from the recipe's first member (the first member is 0.0)

option.description: a token listed in that card's `options` (how a member names exit:wipe + wipe_right); the gate refuses one the card does not list

role.description: one line: what this member does IN the combination (the claim's qualification stamps)

options.description: authoring defaults the preset hands the author (e.g. {"dur": 0.9}); never episode facts

optional.description: true when the seed fired with and without it; the matcher does not require it

build.description: the build dir name, e.g. build-f

timeline.description: repo-relative path of the compiled scene timeline the gate re-walks (must exist on disk)

t.description: the first-fire instant: the first member's time in the timeline's clock

members_at.description: one instant per member, in member order (the audit sheet's frames; the matcher's check); null where an OPTIONAL member is absent at the proof - the gate compares None-ness

scene.description: the scene_id the first member fires in

id.description: recipe:<slug>; the slug is the file name

title.description: the canonical human name - the doc's or the operator's word where one exists; never a card's title or alias (drift gate)

aliases.description: unique across cards AND recipes; never a name in build_effects_catalog.AMBIGUOUS_NAMES (drift gate)

acts.description: the SPECIES-BY-SENTENCE acts the combination serves (the same 11 as effect_card.schema.json `serves`)

members.description: ORDERED; the first member's offset_s is 0.0

window_s.description: the span the members must fall inside for a fire to count (cooc.py's WIN = 6.0); a recipe whose members are docks held across cuts may widen it and say why in `does`

dials.description: the measured laws, as measured (badge ladder: FIRST_BADGE_S 2.05, BADGE_GAP_S 1.30; EMPHASIZE_EQUALS_DATUM true)

dials_source.description: where each dial was measured ('41 of 43 Steel docks, 40 gaps all exactly 1.30'); required whenever dials is present

does.description: one sentence: what the viewer sees the COMBINATION do

doctrine.description: cites resolved through DOCS-INDEX at build (E96, 29 s9.24, CAPABILITIES <row>, BACKLOG R26-103)

source.description: the seed in the spike ('recipes_r1 R1') and T2's re-derived row ('docs/research/runs/p56-recipe-seeds/seeds.jsonl seed R1'), or 'recipes_r1 s4' for a candidate

count.description: how many times the ordered set fired in an approved cut (a recipe that fires once is a decoration; 4x is a grammar); 0 on a candidate

moment.description: hook / setup / proof / turn / reveal / close

shape.description: the data shape the recipe needs

use.description: when to reach for it, one line

use_when.description: P69 T35b / BRAVOS-USE-WHEN.md's fields: an author finds the move by what the sentence is doing
